name: The Secret
source:
This is a visual novel about a young man who, together with his mother, moves to another city. A new college, a new home, a new life. And new stories.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/aorrta]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于一个年轻人和他的母亲搬到另一个城市的视觉小说。新的大学，新的家，新的生活。还有新的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/aorrta]Patreon[/url]]
